sentences.text:
The present petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred by the petitioner seeking free, fair and impartial investigation in a case registered at crime No.306/2023 at Police Station Bahadurpur, district Ashoknagar for offence under Sections 450 and 376(2)(n) of IPC.
2.

It is the submission of learned counsel for the petitioner that on the complaint of petitioner, a case referred above was registered against the accused person i.e. her Dever but till today neither any investigation has been done in the matter nor arrest of the accused has been executed.
The allegation in relation not taking interest on the police has also been made.
It is further alleged that police is not properly investigating the present case.
Thus, prayed for fair and impartial investigation in the matter in hand.
3. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the prayer of the petitioner and submitted that investigation in the case in hand shall be conducted free, fair and impartial.

4. Heard.
5.

Perusal of the case in hand indicates that on the complaint of petitioner a case at crime No.306/2023 at Police Station Bahadurpur, district Ashoknagar for offence under Sections 450 and 376(2)(n) of IPC has been registered.
Petitioner's contention is that police is not investigating the present case properly and not taking interest in the matter.
Since police has not filed challan in the matter therefore, it is too early to conclude about any partiality on part of police in the case in hand.
6. In view of the above fact situation, no case for interference is made out in the extraordinary jurisdiction of this Court.
Once the challan has not been filed in the matter, therefore, it is too early to conclude about the alleged unfairness and partiality of the police.
However, it is expected from the investigating officer to conduct just and fair investigation, keeping in view the contentions raised by the petitioner in this case.
No further order can be passed.
7. Petition stands disposed of.
(ANAND PATHAK)
Anil* JUDGE ANIL KUMAR CHAURASIYA 2023.12.19 10:57:11 +05'30'
